title: Milnor K reconstruction at the characteristic prime
exact_target: For function fields K/k and L/l of transcendence degree at least two over algebraically closed characteristic-p fields, set $V_F=F^times/(F^times)^p$. Does the degree-one/degree-two Milnor product modulo p identify field isomorphisms carrying constants to constants bijectively with product-compatible $F_p-linear$ maps $V_K->V_L$ modulo one common $F_p^times$ scalar?
